security_spec.violation_condition: Kernel or KVM code reads stval (pt_regs->badaddr) for a breakpoint exception (scause=3) and dereferences or forwards it as a valid address (e.g., into si_addr, vstval, htval, or a page table walk), when the breakpoint trigger type is not defined by the ISA to write an address to stval (e.g., an Sdtrig trigger configured for data-without-value match, or an implementation that zeroes stval on non-EBREAK breakpoints).
security_spec.summary: Sstvala no longer guarantees stval contains a valid address for all non-EBREAK breakpoints; kernel must continue using epc (not stval) as si_addr for SIGTRAP delivery and must not forward stval to KVM guests on EXC_BREAKPOINT
